sql: SELECT e.series, count(*) AS barred, round(sum(p.pnl)::numeric,2) AS twin_pnl_usd, round((100*sum(p.pnl)/nullif(sum(p.quantity),0))::numeric,2) AS cents_per_ct FROM live_paper_parity_events e JOIN paper_positions p ON p.market_ticker=e.market_ticker AND p.strategy=e.twin_tag AND p.status='closed' WHERE e.twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND e.twin_outcome='opened' AND e.parent_outcome='skip_live_tier' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY twin_pnl_usd DESC NULLS LAST
